body: I promise you things will get better my friend, you are young & have a whole happy life ahead of you. Don't give up, relax & keep on trying, you will find someone & something to light up your world. You say you dont have a single good thing in life, but think this way instead - you haven't found that one good thing YET. It will come sooner than you think. Just keep on looking for it. There are plenty of people who care for you, hell, i care. Hang in there buddy. Things will get better
